overview: A premium, frontend-only CRM for homeopathy clinics worldwide. Features patient management, appointment scheduling, prescription tracking, billing, AI assistant with demo responses, and a full Pro Features tier with voice-to-text case taking, advanced remedy finder, clinical templates, patient timeline, remedy comparison, case repository, and materia medica browser. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
features: Dashboard with live charts and stats
Pro: Voice-to-text case taking with waveform UI
Pro: Advanced remedy finder with repertorization
Pro: Materia medica browser with 300+ remedies
